interpretation: Final fixed-view draw counts stay 95/7/56/37, with 440 placements, 218 meshes and nine textures. Geometry buffers increase 8.04%. The final paired run has slower frame intervals in the new lane/overview views and faster intervals in the lot view. A separately loaded overview has a 17 ms frame-interval median in both revisions, with more long stalls after the change. GPU/CPU render timings and power limits are retained, rather than treating one wall-clock FPS sample as a stable speed result or claiming a performance improvement. Real phone/VR performance remains unverified.
